newsitem.title: USA: United Tech hires ex-Clinton appointee.
newsitem.headline: United Tech hires ex-Clinton appointee.

text.p: United Technologies Corp. said Wednesday it named Ruth Harkin as senior vice president of international affairs and government relations.
Harkin, 52, was formerly president and chief executive officer of Overseas Private Investment Corp., a position to which she was appointed by President Bill Clinton in 1993.
She will be based in Washington, D.C., and will report to United Technologies' President and Chief Executive Officer George David, the company said in a statement.
The appointment is effective on June 1.
Harkin succeeds William F. Paul, 61, who had earlier announced his intention to retire after a 42-year career with United Technologies.
